name: Blades & Backgrounds
tagline: Where you come from. What you carry.
adds: Every weapon with its own trick (the 2024 weapon masteries), and the 2024 weapons and armour
A character made in the 2024 order: sixteen backgrounds, origin feats, and the peoples in their 2024 form, with orcs
Feats at levels 4 and 8: the 2024 general and fighting style feats, used by your companions and your enemies too
The 2024 tools and adventuring gear, every piece of it doing something: packs, acid, nets, caltrops, antitoxin, ladders
Inns, meals and lifestyles by the book, coaches between towns, ships between harbours, messengers and tolls
Horses that look like horses, camels, elephants and mastiffs, saddles, stabling, and carts and wagons to carry more
A keepsake in every pocket: a hundred trinkets, each with its own small story
